description: Free. Tell BitTuitive what data you want (data_type, description, an example query, and the max price in sats you would pay). This records a demand signal only; it does not add a source or bypass the paywall. New sources need a clearly legal, redistributable origin and an operator go-ahead. Ranked counts are the paid get_market_insights tool; public /api/v1/insights/* pages are teasers only.

contact.description: Optional email so an operator can follow up. Never published.

data_type.description: Category, e.g. weather, stocks, traffic, other.

description.description: What you need and why it would help.

example_query.description: An example query or URL shape you would send.

max_price_sats.description: Max sats you would pay per call.

name: request_data
title: Request a data type BitTuitive does not have yet (free)
